Built for this platform

What you can do with Spotify Ads MCP

01

Inspect campaigns and ad sets

List published campaigns, read ad-set budgets and delivery settings, and request normalized reports for the account, campaign, ad-group, or ad level.

02

Control delivery deliberately

Preview campaign status or ad-set delivery changes. Budget updates preserve the existing DAILY or LIFETIME type instead of treating them as interchangeable.

03

Prepare an unpublished draft

Create a paused, unpublished campaign draft through the policy gate. The connector does not publish a full campaign hierarchy or generate audio assets for you.

Know what the data means

Draft creation is explicitly unpublished. Publishing a complete draft hierarchy, asset creation, audience editing, and deletion are not exposed by this module. API-contract tests are not live-account verification.

Local setup · Bring your own credentials

Connect Spotify Ads to Claude Code or Cursor.

The npm CLI and MCP server run on your machine. You need Node.js 22.13 or newer, your own provider credentials, and permission to access the ad account.

01 Install Adport

npm install -g adport

02 Connect Spotify Ads

adport connect spotify

The local wizard opens the Ads authorization flow, discovers accessible accounts, and saves a permission-restricted grant. Spotify’s music-library scopes are not a substitute for Ads API access.

03 Check your connection

adport doctor
adport accounts --provider spotify

Check that the intended account appears before asking your agent to report on it. Never paste tokens, client secrets, or private keys into chat.

Before you connect

  • A Spotify developer app with the Ads API selected and access to your advertising business.
  • Completion of Spotify’s Ads API access requirements for that client ID in Ads Manager.
  • The callback http://127.0.0.1:53685/callback, your client ID, and SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET supplied securely in the environment.
Full Spotify Ads connection guideOfficial Spotify Ads API documentation

Adport is independent and is not endorsed by Spotify Ads. Provider access and approval are separate from installing this package.

Use Spotify Ads from your agent.

Spotify Ads in Claude Code

After connecting locally, register Adport as a stdio MCP server:

claude mcp add --transport stdio adport -- adport mcp

Start a new session and ask Claude to list your connected Spotify Ads accounts.

Claude Code MCP documentation

Spotify Ads in Cursor

Add this entry to your Cursor MCP configuration. Merge it with existing servers rather than replacing them:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "adport": {
      "command": "adport",
      "args": [
        "mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}

The command must be available on Cursor’s PATH. Enable the server and ask the agent to inspect your account.

You stay in control

A suggestion is not a live change.

The first mutation call returns a preview and a short-lived pending-operation token. Applying requires that token and the same arguments. Budget caps and protected accounts are checked by the policy engine; new campaigns are paused by policy.

Local operations are recorded in an append-only audit log. An approved preview is not a guarantee of provider acceptance, and a connected agent does not grant additional account permissions.

Spotify Ads MCP questions

Is this the same as a Spotify music MCP?

No. This integration is for Spotify advertising businesses, campaigns, reports, and ad sets. It does not control playback, playlists, or a listener’s music library.

Can I use Spotify Ads locally without Adport Cloud?

Yes. Install Adport from npm, connect your own Spotify Ads credentials, and register the local MCP server with a stdio-compatible agent such as Claude Code or Cursor. Your provider may have its own approval, access, or billing requirements.

Why can I connect an account but not read a report or apply a change?

Account discovery, reporting, and mutations can require different permissions. Check the requested account, provider app scopes, advertiser eligibility, and environment. Start with adport doctor and the connection guide above. Do not bypass a denied operation by sharing secrets with the agent.
